3. whenever a creature fails its passive save to end your ongoing harm, it gets -1 resistance vs fortitude attacks for 1 round
4. the first tick of ongoing harm a creature takes is increased by 3
5. +1 outgoing poison harm
6. on limited power hit, any ongoing harm on the target spreads to all your foes within 5' of the target

startingAffixes.description: on ranged hit, the target makes a save, becoming slowed for 1 round on a fail
startingAffixes.upgrade: creatures have -1 to their saves vs the slowed condition from you/3

startingAffixes.description: on ranged hit, the target gets -1 resistance vs reflex attacks for 1 round
on ranged hit, the target gets +1 bludgeoning resistance for 1 round

thematicAffixes.description: 1. on ranged hit, the target moves down 1 space in the initiative tracker
2. on ranged hit, the target gets -1 lightning resistance for 1 round
3. your ranged attacks deal +1d4 lightning damage
4. on ranged hit vs a slowed creature, the maximum duration of their slow is increased by 1 round
5. +1 ranged damage
6. if your Intelligence is 15+, +1 ranged damage

startingAffixes.description: +1 survival
+2 to your Hunt & Gather journey activity checks
on a Hunt & Gather journey activity standard success, you gain +1 Supply

thematicAffixes.description: 1. on a Hunt & Gather journey activity critical success, you gain +2 Supply
2. whenever you gain Supply from the Hunt & Gather journey activity, you gain additional Supply equal to your bonus survival
3. while journeying with a sidekick, you gain +2 Supply whenever you gain Supply from the Hunt & Gather journey activity
4. Tiny party members you are journeying with, including yourself, do not consume Supply
5. +1 Hunt & Gather journey activity critical success range
6. +2 to your survival checks to navigate

startingAffixes.description: +2 outgoing healing vs yourself
+3 outgoing temporary HP vs yourself
+4 maximum HP

thematicAffixes.description: 1. +1 incoming temporary HP equal to your bonus maximum HP
2. on ranged hit, your next melee attack deals +1 damage
3. on ranged hit, the next instance of temporary HP you grant has a +3 bonus
4. +1 spell damage
5. +2 outgoing healing
6. +3 outgoing temporary HP

startingAffixes.description: +2 outgoing harm with persistent zones
+5' to your persistent zone area sizes

whenever you score a standard success with an area attack, choose a space within its area and create a 5'x5' persistent zone centred there that lasts for the remainder of combat and causes 1 cold harm to foes

thematicAffixes.description: 1. on area attack, +1 outgoing harm for the remainder of combat
2. on your first area attack between short rests, creatures have -1 to their saves against your effects that stagger for the remainder of combat
3. on area attack, +1 outgoing harm for 1 round
4. on area attack, creatures have -1 to their saves against your effects that stagger for 1 round
5. on area attack, choose a space within its area and create a 5'x5' persistent zone centred there that lasts for the remainder of combat and causes 1 cold harm to foes
6. your area attacks cost -1 exertion or -1 spell slot level, to a minimum of 1

startingAffixes.description: on using a non-attack standard action power, gain +1 melee damage for the remainder of combat
on melee attack, gain +1 melee damage until you finish your turn having not made a melee attack
if you've used a non-attack standard action power this combat, you have +1 melee damage

thematicAffixes.description: 1. on using a non-attack standard action power, gain +1 minion melee damage until you finish your turn having not made a melee attack
2. on using a non-attack standard action power, gain +1 melee damage until you finish your turn having not made a melee attack
3. on using a non-attack standard action power, gain +1 resistance for 1 round
4. on using a non-attack standard action power, heal 1 HP
5. on using a non-attack standard action power while bloodied, heal 2 HP
6. on using a non-attack standard action power, all adjacent foes gain -1 damage for 1 round
